meaning_en: to forge / hammer hot iron on the anvil

past.de: Der Schmied hämmerte das glühende Eisen
past.en: The blacksmith hammered the glowing iron

present.de: Er schmiedet die Klinge kraftvoll auf dem Amboss
present.en: He hammers the blade on the anvil with resolve

imperative.de: Schmiede das Eisen, solange es heiß ist!
imperative.en: Strike the iron while it is hot!
